soru: Uzaktan kumandalı dört bacaklı robotların iletişim ve kontrol altyapısına yönelik siber güvenlik zafiyetleri, tehditler ve savunmalar üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Uzaktan kumandalı dört bacaklı robotların iletişim ve kontrol altyapısına yönelik siber güvenlik zafiyetleri, tehditler ve savunmalar üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-01-26. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first), each with its arXiv id and/or DOI. You may search the web.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: On the (In)Security of Secure ROS2
calismalar.gerekce: Identifies basic design flaws in SROS2/DDS security, which most ROS 2-based quadruped control stacks (Unitree Go2, CyberDog) rely on.

calismalar.baslik: The Cybersecurity of a Humanoid Robot: An Early Study via the Unitree G1
calismalar.gerekce: The first broad security analysis of a Unitree platform, covering firmware, network traffic, DDS exposure and cloud telemetry; its findings carry over to Unitree's quadruped line, which shares the same software ecosystem.

calismalar.baslik: Cybersecurity AI: Humanoid Robots as Attack Vectors
calismalar.gerekce: Shows that Unitree's FMX encryption can be broken and that the robot continuously sends telemetry to external servers, demonstrating that robots can act as Trojan horses.

calismalar.baslik: Jailbreaking LLM-Controlled Robots
calismalar.gerekce: RoboPAIR shows harmful physical actions can be triggered through the LLM-based command interface of a real Unitree Go2 quadruped.

calismalar.baslik: Rethinking Robustness Assessment: Adversarial Attacks on Learning-based Quadrupedal Locomotion Controllers
calismalar.gerekce: Shows systematically that adversarial command and observation perturbations can make RL-based quadruped controllers fall.

calismalar.baslik: Robotics cyber security: vulnerabilities, attacks, countermeasures, and recommendations
calismalar.gerekce: A widely cited survey offering a basic taxonomy of robot vulnerabilities, attacks and countermeasures.

calismalar.baslik: Cyber security of robots: A comprehensive survey
calismalar.gerekce: A comprehensive survey that brings together robot communication, control and software security.

calismalar.baslik: Security Considerations in AI-Robotics: A Survey of Current Methods, Challenges, and Opportunities
calismalar.gerekce: Sets out the attack surfaces and open problems of AI-based robots across the perception, planning and control layers.

calismalar.baslik: Security for the Robot Operating System
calismalar.gerekce: A foundational study of authentication and authorization for ROS communication.

calismalar.baslik: SROS2: Usable Cyber Security Tools for ROS 2
calismalar.gerekce: Describes SROS2, the reference defense tooling for encryption and access control on ROS 2 communication.

calismalar.baslik: An Experimental Security Analysis of an Industrial Robot Controller
calismalar.gerekce: A landmark empirical study showing that attacks on a robot controller can compromise physical safety.

calismalar.baslik: To Make a Robot Secure: An Experimental Analysis of Cyber Security Threats Against Teleoperated Surgical Robots
calismalar.gerekce: The classic experimental work showing man-in-the-middle and DoS attacks on a teleoperated robot.

calismalar.baslik: Targeted Attacks on Teleoperated Surgical Robots: Dynamic Model-Based Detection and Mitigation
calismalar.gerekce: Introduces dynamic-model-based detection of malicious commands in teleoperated robots.

calismalar.baslik: On Cyber-Physical Attacks in Bilateral Teleoperation Systems: An Experimental Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: Experimentally analyzes how network attacks affect the stability of bilateral teleoperation loops.

calismalar.baslik: Cyber-Secure Teleoperation With Encrypted Four-Channel Bilateral Control
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes a control-level encryption defense for teleoperation channels.

calismalar.baslik: Robot Operating System 2: The need for a holistic security approach to robotic architectures
calismalar.gerekce: Evaluates the practical implementation and limits of the DDS Security plugins in ROS 2.

calismalar.baslik: Security and Performance Considerations in ROS 2: A Balancing Act
calismalar.gerekce: Measures the latency and performance cost that DDS security imposes on real-time control.

calismalar.baslik: Supply Chain Exploitation of Secure ROS 2 Systems: A Proof-of-Concept on Autonomous Platform Compromise via Keystore Exfiltration
calismalar.gerekce: Shows SROS2 keystores can be stolen through a supply-chain attack, exposing an open problem.

calismalar.baslik: Introducing the Robot Vulnerability Database (RVD)
calismalar.gerekce: Created the vulnerability database used to systematically catalogue robot vulnerabilities.

calismalar.baslik: Towards an open standard for assessing the severity of robot security vulnerabilities, the Robot Vulnerability Scoring System (RVSS)
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes a robot-specific vulnerability severity scoring standard that accounts for physical consequences.

calismalar.baslik: Formal Analysis and Detection for ROS2 Communication Security Vulnerability
calismalar.gerekce: Uses formal methods to identify and detect seven vulnerability types in ROS 2 communication.

calismalar.baslik: Secure Robotics: Navigating Challenges at the Nexus of Safety, Trust, and Cybersecurity in Cyber-Physical Systems
calismalar.gerekce: An up-to-date ACM Computing Surveys review that treats safety, trust and cybersecurity together.

calismalar.baslik: BadRobot: Jailbreaking Embodied LLMs in the Physical World
calismalar.gerekce: Systematizes jailbreak threats against the language-based command interfaces of embodied robots.

calismalar.baslik: Robot hazards: from safety to security
calismalar.gerekce: Frames how robot cybersecurity vulnerabilities turn into physical safety hazards.

calismalar.baslik: Introducing the Robot Security Framework (RSF), a standardized methodology to perform security assessments in robotics
calismalar.gerekce: Offers a standard layered methodology for robot security assessments.

calismalar.baslik: Hacking Robots Before Skynet
calismalar.gerekce: An influential industry report revealing widespread authentication and encryption weaknesses in commercial robots.

calismalar.baslik: Jamming Attacks and Anti-Jamming Strategies in Wireless Networks: A Comprehensive Survey
calismalar.gerekce: Systematizes jamming threats and countermeasures for the wireless links (Wi-Fi/4G/BLE) used for remote control.

calismalar.baslik: CAI: An Open, Bug Bounty-Ready Cybersecurity AI
calismalar.gerekce: An AI-assisted security testing framework used in assessments of Unitree robots.

calismalar.baslik: RTPS Attack Dataset Description
calismalar.gerekce: Provides an attack dataset for DDS/RTPS traffic to support intrusion detection research.

calismalar.baslik: Securing Cyber-Physical Robotic Systems for Enhanced Data Security and Real-Time Threat Mitigation
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes an attack-tree analysis and real-time threat mitigation for robotic cyber-physical systems.
